messages:
maya: quick heads-up — canary run for quantized-llama3q on runtime-2.14 shows a 3% P99 regression vs yesterday. noisy but repeatable on two canary machines.
ken: do we have traces or logs? can you paste the failing request id?
maya: request id c8f2a3. logs:
```
2026-03-18T22:14:02Z ERROR kv_cache: eviction triggered, alloc failed: OOM while allocating 512MB for cache shard 3
2026-03-18T22:14:02Z WARN runtime: fallback to unoptimized kernel for attention
```
olivia: hmm looks like memory pressure on quantized path. could be a new kernel selection change in sdk 1.6.0 that regresses longseq allocations.
samir: are we seeing this on prod or just canary?
maya: only canary so far (2 machines in us-west1), but the metric is consistent across runs.
maya: my ask — temporarily pin SDK->runtime binding to sdk 1.5.2 for canary pool while we root cause. open to objections.
ken: +1. prefer pin at cluster-level rather than runtime global.
deploybot: Lock created: pin(sdk=1.5.2,scope=canary) by @maya — ticket RDW-9876. Apply window starting now. (action taken: pinned on canary-2 and canary-3)
ops-oncall: looped in. set alert to warn at 1% delta so we get notified if it creeps.
olivia: I'll start a bisect between 1.5.2 and 1.6.0 kernels, and test with synthetic longseq workload. will update RDW-9876 with results.
samir: do we need to pin any model variants too? my read: model isn't changed, it's the SDK/kernel path.
maya: agree — no model pin for now. keep model unpinned. we'll revert pin when kernel patch lands and perf is validated.
ken: plan for revert: add an expiry to the pin and a follow-up label "revert-after-kernel-fix". Also add smoke tests for longseq P99.
maya: pin expiry set to 2026-03-25T12:00:00Z in ticket. if fix lands earlier we can unpin manually.
olivia: adding the config snippet I'm pushing to infra so deploybot can read:
```
pin:
  component: sdk
  version: "1.5.2"
  scope: canary
  expires: "2026-03-25T12:00:00Z"
  reason: "P99 regression on quantized longseqs after sdk 1.6.0 kernel change"
```
deploybot: action log: pinned sdk=1.5.2 on pools [canary-2, canary-3]; created follow-up RDW-9877 for kernel bisect.
maya: thanks all. any other blockers? :thumbsup:
ken: nothing from my side. :+1:
ops-oncall: monitoring set. will escalate if regression appears in prod.
olivia: will post updates in RDW-9876 and close pin when we validate fix.
maya: closing thread here unless more obs. thanks.
